typeText:
∀ {k : Nat} {g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance} {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SPre4 k g m →
    And (LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1)))
      (And
        (LE.le.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1)) 2)
          (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP))
        (And (LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2)))
          (And
            (LE.le.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2)) 2)
              (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP))
            (And
              (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepNode m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN
                (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1))
                (List.getD.{0}
                  (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))
                  (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.X_ 1)) (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Node.src 0)))
              (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepNode m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN
                (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2))
                (List.getD.{0}
                  (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))
                  (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.I_ 0)) (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Node.src 0)))))))

source.code:
theorem SPre4.recs {k : ℕ} {g : GInstance} {m : Mem} (h : SPre4 k g m) :
    IN ≤ m (G_ 1) ∧ m (G_ 1) + 2 ≤ m HP ∧ IN ≤ m (G_ 2) ∧ m (G_ 2) + 2 ≤ m HP ∧
      RepNode m IN (m HP) (m (G_ 1)) (g.base.nodes.getD (m (X_ 1)) (.src 0)) ∧
      RepNode m IN (m HP) (m (G_ 2)) (g.base.nodes.getD (m (I_ 0)) (.src 0)) := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hg1, hg2, _, _⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨⟨_, _, a3, a4, a5⟩, ⟨_, _, b3, b4, b5⟩⟩ := hs.nodes
  rw [hg1, hg2]
  exact ⟨a3, a4, b3, b4, a5, b5⟩
